title: Hitting a fade
description: Aim your body left and set the clubface a little open to that line, pointing between your body line and the target.
tips: Aim your feet, hips and shoulders left of the target and swing along that line.
Set the clubface a little open to your stance, pointing just left of the target.
Ball starts left and curves gently back to the target (left-handers: mirror this).
A fade flies a touch higher and lands softer, so it stops quicker.
